subject: Auth & Key Management: Integration playbook and action items
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@finova.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-09T16:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + infra overview — auth & keys

Thanks for taking the call today — quick recap and proposed path forward so we have a single place for action items. High level notes: 
- Finova: low-latency inference for risk scoring, strict rotation policies, SSO + SCIM enabled across platform.
- Primary constraint: security team prefers service accounts with short-lived tokens, but engineering needs simple SDK onboarding for dev/test.

Recommended approach (opinionated):
1) PoC: create a read-only service account for embeddings/rerank calls that uses JWT exchange (OIDC) for short-lived tokens; provide an API key fallback for initial SDK tests only.
2) Prod: issue long-lived service account (rotated via KMS + scheduled rotation) that mints 1h JWT tokens for microservices. No app-level static API keys in prod.
3) Developer experience: SDKs support both API key env var and service-account JSON flow; add a CLI helper to exchange SA JSON -> token for local dev.

Action items (owners):
- Finova: confirm SSO provider and SCIM attributes (Priya) — answer by Wed 5/13.
- Redwood: share integration playbook + sample JWT exchange code (Rishi) — by Mon 5/11.
- Security checkpoint: Monica to validate rotation cadence and KMS options — by Tue 5/12.

I attached a short playbook draft and the SSO checklist you mentioned. I also pasted a tiny curl + node SDK example below to unblock devs. If this matches your expectations, we can schedule a 30-min infra deep-dive (proposal: Thu 5/14).

-- sample curl (short-lived JWT flow) --
# 1) Service account JSON -> POST to /v1/token-exchange
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/token-exchange \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"service_account":"<service-account-json>","aud":"redwood-token"}'

# 2) Use returned bearer token
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <short_lived_token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

Cheers,
Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T01:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Auth & Key Management: Integration playbook and action items

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our infra team: 
1) Does Redwood support OIDC on the token endpoint for service accounts (we'd like to integrate with our internal identity broker)?
2) For local dev, we need a path that doesn't require full SSO — is the CLI helper you mentioned something you can share?
3) What logging/retention do you have for token minting events? Security requires 1y audit records.

We're attaching our SSO provider details in the PDF (finova_sso_requirements.pdf). For the PoC, we'd like a temporary API key so our frontend engineers can start integrating while infra works on SA flow. Can you confirm the scope/limits on temp keys and whether they can be set to auto-expire?

Also looping in our infra lead, Ethan, if he has bandwidth for the deep dive on Thu.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Platform Engineering Lead, Finova

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Auth & Key Management: Integration playbook and action items

Priya — quick answers while I validate with security: 
- OIDC: yes, our token-exchange supports OIDC/JWT validation and we can chain to your identity broker. I'll confirm supported claims tomorrow.
- Local CLI helper: attaching a first-draft playbook (redwood-integration-playbook-v1.md) — includes a node/python snippet for SA->token exchange and an env var API_KEY fallback.
- Auditing: we retain token mint logs for 13 months and can export to your Splunk/S3.

On temp API keys: we support time-limited keys (TTL configurable at creation) and granular scopes (generate, embeddings, admin). For the PoC: propose a scoped key (embeddings:read, generate:dev) with 7-day TTL. Marcus — can you provision a scoped temp key for Finova and share the creation link?

Monica
VP, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.ai>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@finova.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Auth & Key Management: Integration playbook and action items

On Mon, May 11, 2026 at 09:04 AM Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our infra team: 
> 1) Does Redwood support OIDC on the token endpoint for service accounts (we'd like to integrate with our internal identity broker)?
> 2) For local dev, we need a path that doesn't require full SSO — is the CLI helper you mentioned something you can share?
> 3) What logging/retention do you have for token minting events? Security requires 1y audit records.

Thanks for the PDF, Priya — confirmed receipt. Quick updates and next steps: 
- Marcus: I've asked for a scoped temp API key (embeddings:read, generate:dev) with TTL 7d. Expect link by EOD 5/11.
- Monica: thanks for confirming retention and OIDC support — please send the exact claim list (aud/iss/sub) so Finova can wire the broker.
- Rishi -> Finova: I'll drop the CLI helper and the minimal node/python snippets in the HubSpot deal (link above) and attach to this thread. For the PoC please use the temp key for frontend devs and plan to switch to SA JWT for backend services.

Minimal Node SDK example (service-account flow):
const redwood = require('@redwoodai/sdk');
const client = redwood.serviceAccount({ keyFile: './finova-sa.json' });
const token = await client.exchange(); // returns short-lived bearer
const resp = await client.generate({ prompt: 'summarize tx' }, { auth: token });

Next meeting: propose Thu 2026-05-14 11:00am ET for infra deep-dive (zoom). Please confirm availability.

Action summary: 
- Finova (Priya): confirm SSO provider attributes by 2026-05-13.
- Redwood (Marcus): share temp API key link (by EOD 5/11).
- Redwood (Monica): share OIDC claim expectations (by 5/12).
- Redwood (Rishi): upload CLI helper + snippets to HubSpot and attach here (by 5/11).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.
Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: finova_sso_requirements.pdf, redwood-integration-playbook-v1.md"
